description: An MIT-licensed fork of Git Graph with visual history, branch actions, and devcontainer support.
config.autoCenterCommitDetailsView: Automatically center the commit details view when it is opened.
config.dateFormat: Specifies the date format to be used in the date column of Git Graph.
config.dateFormat.dateTime: Show the date and time, for example "19 Mar 2019 21:34"
config.dateFormat.dateOnly: Show the date only, for example "19 Mar 2019"
config.dateFormat.relative: Show relative times, for example "5 minutes ago"
config.dateType: Specifies the date type to be displayed throughout Git Graph.
config.dateType.authorDate: Use the author date of a commit
config.dateType.commitDate: Use the committer date of a commit
config.fetchAvatars: No effect. Earlier versions fetched commit author avatars; that feature has been removed.
config.fetchAvatars.deprecation: Deprecated in v0.6.0. This setting has no effect and may be removed in a future release.
config.graphColours: Specifies the colours used on the graph.
config.graphStyle: Specifies the style of the graph.
config.graphStyle.rounded: Use smooth curves when transitioning between branches on the graph
config.graphStyle.angular: Use angular lines when transitioning between branches on the graph
config.initialLoadCommits: Specifies the number of commits to initially load.
config.loadMoreCommits: Specifies the number of commits to load when the "Load More Commits" button is pressed (only shown when more commits are available).
config.maxDepthOfRepoSearch: Specifies the maximum depth of subfolders to search when discovering repositories in the workspace.
config.showCurrentBranchByDefault: Show the current branch by default when Git Graph is opened. Default: false (show all branches)
config.showUncommittedChanges: Show uncommitted changes (set to false to decrease load time on large repositories).
config.tabIconColourTheme: Specifies the colour theme of the icon displayed on the Git Graph tab.
config.tabIconColourTheme.colour: Show a colour icon which suits most Visual Studio Code colour themes
config.tabIconColourTheme.grey: Show a grey icon which suits Visual Studio Code colour themes that are predominantly grayscale
walkthrough.title: Get started with (neo) Git Graph
walkthrough.description: Open the graph, read it, act on commits and branches, and recover from mistakes.
walkthrough.openGraph.title: Open the graph
walkthrough.openGraph.description:
Click the Git Graph button in the Source Control view or the status bar, or run the command.
[Open Git Graph](command:neo-git-graph.view)
walkthrough.readGraph.title: Read the graph
walkthrough.readGraph.description: Each row is a commit. Labels show branches, tags and remotes, the checked-out branch is bold, and uncommitted changes sit on top.
walkthrough.actOnCommit.title: Act on a commit
walkthrough.actOnCommit.description: Right-click a commit or click its ⋯ button for checkout, cherry-pick, revert, tag, branch and more. Every change asks for confirmation first.
walkthrough.branchesPane.title: Use the Branches pane
walkthrough.branchesPane.description:
Browse branches, remotes, tags and stashes beside the graph, with checkout, fetch and apply one click away.
[Show the Branches pane](command:neo-git-graph.showBranches)
walkthrough.focusAndRemotes.title: Focus a branch and hide remotes
walkthrough.focusAndRemotes.description:
Highlight one branch's history without hiding the others, and keep a noisy remote's branches out of the graph.
[Show the Branches pane](command:neo-git-graph.showBranches)
walkthrough.recover.title: Recover from a mistake
walkthrough.recover.description:
The status strip offers Continue and Abort during merges and rebases, Git Activity keeps every error, and Recover lost commits finds old branch positions.
[Open the documentation](command:neo-git-graph.openDocumentation)
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: Git Graph runs Git on local files, which a virtual workspace does not have.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Git Graph runs Git, which can start programs that the repository's configuration names.
